# Кошка Шрёдингера / Schrödinger’s Cat

> A bilingual Russian/English literary and philosophical website featuring poetry, articles, and a Russian-language book.

Discussions of physics, time, cosmology, and philosophy present the author's reflections and hypotheses. Content availability differs between the Russian and English sections, as noted below.

## Russian sections

- [Кошка Шрёдингера](https://schrodingercat.org/): Russian homepage.
- [Статьи](https://schrodingercat.org/articles/): Articles in Russian.
- [Поэзия](https://schrodingercat.org/poeziya/): Poems in Russian; the listing spans three pages.
- [Проза](https://schrodingercat.org/proza/): Prose section; currently contains only a heading, with no prose texts listed.
- [Кошка Шрёдингера о теории всего в стиле «пэчворк»](https://schrodingercat.org/kniga/): Book by Елена Березина (Elena Berezina), with information and PDF links in Russian.
- [О проекте](https://schrodingercat.org/about/): About text in Russian.

## English sections

- [Schrödinger’s Cat](https://schrodingercat.org/en/): English homepage; also links to Russian-language poetry and the book.
- [Articles](https://schrodingercat.org/en/articles/): Existing English translations of articles.
- [Poetry](https://schrodingercat.org/en/poetry/): Placeholder containing only a heading; no English poems are listed.
- [Prose](https://schrodingercat.org/en/prose/): Prose section; currently contains only a heading, with no prose texts listed.
- [Book](https://schrodingercat.org/en/book/): Placeholder containing only a heading; no English book translation is provided.
- [About](https://schrodingercat.org/en/about/): About text in English.

## Book PDF

- [Original Russian-language PDF](https://schrodingercat.org/assets/books/koshka-shredingera.pdf): Кошка Шрёдингера о теории всего в стиле «пэчворк», by Елена Березина (Elena Berezina). The book is in Russian.

## Site index

- [Sitemap](https://schrodingercat.org/sitemap.xml): Public HTML page URLs, including individual articles, poems, and poetry pagination pages.
